newsitem.title: USA: Payless ShoeSource July same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Payless ShoeSource July same store sales up.

text.p: Payless ShoeSource Inc said Thursday its same store sales for the four weeks ended August 2, 1997 rose 2.2 percent from the comparable period a year ago.
Total sales in July increased 8.4 percent to $181.3 million from $167.3 million last year, the footwear retailer said in a news release.

Same store sales for the six months to August 2, 1997 were up 6.7 percent while total sales rose 10.4 percent from a year ago to $1.36 billion. Results for 1997 include sales of Parade of Shoes stores from March 10, the day the stores were acquired.
Payless ShoeSource operates 4,223 stores compared with 4,280 stores a year ago.
